lp.nav.label: Page sections
lp.about.title: Travel relaxed. Park premium.
lp.about.text: Luxury Parking is in Ratingen, close to Düsseldorf Airport (DUS). Park your car safely with us and take the shuttle to the airport – when you are back, we pick you up there again.
lp.features.title: Your benefits
lp.f1.d: Video-monitored site, secured around the clock.
lp.f2.d: After parking, our shuttle takes you straight to Düsseldorf Airport.
lp.f3.d: After your trip we collect you at the airport and bring you back to your car.
lp.f4.d: A large share of our spaces is covered; the rest are open-air.
lp.f5.d: The shuttle seats up to two people including luggage.
lp.f6.d: Choose your space on the live map and see the total price right away.
lp.process.title: It’s that simple
lp.s1.d: Reserve online and enter your travel dates.
lp.s2.d: Drive to the lot in Ratingen on your travel day.
lp.s3.d: Leave your car and take the shuttle to the airport.
lp.s4.d: After your trip we pick you up at the airport and take you to your car.
lp.loc.title: Find Luxury Parking here

lp.loc.maps_note: Google Maps only opens after you click.
lp.faq.a1: Luxury Parking is in Ratingen, close to Düsseldorf Airport.
lp.faq.q2: How do I get to the airport?
lp.faq.a2: After parking, our shuttle takes you comfortably to Düsseldorf Airport.
lp.faq.q3: How do I get back after my trip?
lp.faq.a3: After you return, we pick you up at the airport and take you back to our parking lot.
lp.faq.a4: Yes. Our site is video-monitored and secured around the clock.
lp.faq.a5: Yes. A large share of our parking spaces is covered.
lp.faq.q6: How many people can ride the shuttle?
lp.faq.a6: Our shuttle seats up to two people including luggage.
lp.cta.title: Ready for a relaxed trip?
lp.cta.text: Secure your parking space in Ratingen now – with a shuttle to Düsseldorf Airport.
